description: The shared static asset CDN of the Aphrody category repositories (aphrody-ui design assets, aphrody-ai brand assets), owned and operated by aphrody-infra. One owner repository per file content; the CDN serves every source under one origin. Built and published by scripts/assets/cdn.ts, served by nginx/aphrody/aphrody-cdn-static.inc on the cdn.aphrody.com vhost.

cdn.note: The release tree /srv/aphrody-cdn and the cdn.aphrody.com vhost (nginx/aphrody/aphrody-nie-cdn.conf) were removed from vps with the Aphrody retirement (inventory/vps-source.json). The catalog stays the redeploy shape: `cdn.ts publish` recreates the release root, then the vhost and a certificate must be installed again. The all-in-one bundle does not carry it.

sources.owns: Material 3 design system: fonts, Google design references, UI screenshots and art direction, Chrome web app captures. The scope keeps its historical name os so published /s/os/ URLs stay stable.
Aphrody agent brand (Byron), product captures and renders.

policy.singleOwner: A file content (sha256) lives in exactly one source; a copy in another repository is a check error.
policy.licences: Fonts ship with their OFL.txt; third-party brand files stay reference material and are served noindex.
policy.exclusions: PSD sources stay in git, never on the CDN.
